title: 第23章 一剑破空第24章 赵玄龙的惊讶
content_zh:
晋级名单公布的时候，顾渊正坐在医疗棚外的石阶上。
他的左肩缠着绷带，白色布料下透出淡淡的血渍。
右臂涂了绿色药膏，凉丝丝的。
大腿的伤口缝了七针，每一针穿过皮肉时，顾渊都没有出声。
他只是坐着，背脊挺直，铁剑横在膝上，剑身上还残留着干结的血迹。
朱八斗坐在他旁边，庞大的身躯占了大半条石阶。
围裙不见了，换成灰色麻布短打。
瞳孔里那种暗红色的光芒已经消退，恢复了原本的圆润和温和。
“陈牧没事。“
朱八斗开口，声音很低：“医师说没伤到内脏，养一个月就好。“
顾渊“嗯“了一声。
“他睡了。“
朱八斗又说：“睡之前说了一句话。“
顾渊转过头。
“他说，'我守住了。'“
朱八斗模仿着陈牧低沉沙哑的语调：“就这三个字，然后眼皮一翻，睡得跟死猪一样。“
顾渊没有说话。
手指轻轻抚过剑身上的缺口——那是格挡赵玄龙的长剑时崩出的，拇指大小。
他的胸口，金色印记在衣服下面隐隐发烫。
不是温热，是灼热，像有烧红的炭埋在皮肤下面。

但他没有说，只是坐着，和平时休息时一样的姿态。
“下一场。“
朱八斗突然说：“单人赛。“
顾渊抬起头。
“混战晋级的九十九个人，抽签一对一。“
朱八斗的圆脸绷紧了：“我刚才去看了公告板。“
他说到这里，停顿了一下。
“你的对手——“
朱八斗的声音变得很轻：“是赵玄龙。“
顾渊的手指停在铁剑的缺口上。
“他的五个盟友全出局了。“
朱八斗继续说：“他一个人晋级，没受伤。状态——是满的。“
顾渊没有回答。
站起身，铁剑在手中转了一个角度。
他的腿还在隐隐作痛，但他站得很稳，背脊笔直。
“你的伤——“
朱八斗想说些什么，但看到顾渊的眼神，话到嘴边又咽了回去。
他叹了口气，摸出两个肉包子塞进顾渊手里：“吃。就算输，也得吃饱了再输。“
顾渊咬了一口，嚼了三下，咽下去。
另一个塞回朱八斗手里。

“够了。“
七号擂台在演武场的东侧。
和混战不同，单人赛的擂台被重新修缮过。
content_en:
When the promotion list was announced, Gu Yuan was sitting on the stone steps outside the medical shed.
His left shoulder was wrapped in a bandage, and there were faint blood stains under the white cloth.
The right arm was smeared with green ointment, which made it feel cool.
The wound on the thigh required seven stitches. Gu Yuan made no sound as each stitch passed through the flesh.
He just sat with his back straight, the iron sword across his knees, and there were still dried blood stains on the sword.
Zhu Badou sat next to him, his huge body taking up most of the stone steps.
The apron was gone, replaced by a gray linen bunt.
The dark red light in his pupils has faded, returning to its original roundness and gentleness.
"Chen Mu is fine."
Zhu Badou spoke in a low voice: "The doctor said that the internal organs were not injured and that it will be fine in a month."
Gu Yuan said "hmm".
"He slept."
Zhu Badou added: "I said something before going to bed."
Gu Yuan turned his head.
"He said, 'I'm holding on.'"
Zhu Badou imitated Chen Mu's low and hoarse tone: "Just these three words, and then his eyelids rolled up and he slept like a dead pig."
Gu Yuan said nothing.
His fingers gently stroked the notch on the sword - it was the size of a thumb that broke out when he blocked Zhao Xuanlong's long sword.
On his chest, the golden mark was faintly hot under his clothes.
It's not warm, it's burning, like red-hot coals buried under the skin.
But he didn't say anything, he just sat in the same posture as when he was resting.
"Next game."
Zhu Badou suddenly said: "Single match."
Gu Yuan raised his head.
"The ninety-nine people who advance in the melee will be drawn one-on-one."
Zhu Badou's round face tightened: "I just went to see the bulletin board."
When he said this, he paused.
"Your opponent—"
Zhu Badou's voice became very soft: "It's Zhao Xuanlong."
Gu Yuan's fingers stopped on the gap of the iron sword.
"All five of his allies are out."
Zhu Badou continued: "He advanced alone and was not injured. His condition is full."
Gu Yuan didn't answer.
He stood up and turned the iron sword at an angle in his hand.
His legs still ached, but he stood firm, his back straight.
"Your injury-"
Zhu Badou wanted to say something, but seeing the look in Gu Yuan's eyes, he swallowed his words again.
He sighed, took out two meat buns and stuffed them into Gu Yuan's hand: "Eat. Even if you lose, you have to eat until you are full before losing."
Gu Yuan took a bite, chewed it three times, and swallowed it.
The other one was stuffed back into Zhu Badou's hand.
"That's enough."
Arena No. 7 is on the east side of the martial arts arena.
Unlike the melee, the arena for the singles competition has been renovated.
